name: Oppressive Ruin extends Ruin's heal-absorb duration to 8 sec (#983)
contract: Ruin's heal-absorb effect (aura 301, targets 801895/501292-501299/563730-563735/802677/807429) has a base duration of 0 ms (DurationIndex 0). Oppressive Ruin 561201 adds a flat SPELLMOD_DURATION of 8000 ms (stored 7999, resolved 8000 via the DieSides==1 +1 rule). Ruin costs 2 Felfury (AscensionCompatData::ResourceCostRules, class 14, spell 801895, resource spell 800058, amount 2); without that resource stack, OnSpellCheckCast fails the cast with SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER before either effect ever runs, so the fixture grants Felfury via set_aura first. Ruin also has a real, non-instant cast (SpellCastTimes.dbc entry 19 = 2500 ms base cast time, PowerType 3/Energy, ManaCost 30 -- both satisfied by this fixture) plus a 30 units/sec projectile (Speed field); the 'cast' action only submits CMSG_CAST_SPELL and returns immediately, so an assertion with no within_ms window is evaluated before the 2.5 sec cast bar finishes and finds no aura yet, indistinguishable from a cast that never landed. The talented assertion polls for up to within_ms to let the cast and travel resolve before checking the resulting aura's duration.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
